extracted.intended_audience: general users needing length/unit conversion (students, DIYers, shoppers, engineers)
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step guidance and reference material for converting a length given in centimeters (cm) to feet (ft), including definitions, the conversion factor/formula, worked examples, and a conversion table.

rubrics_metrics.name: Centimeter definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Centimeter (cm) or centimetre is a unit of length in the International System of Units (SI). Centi is a prefix for 1/100. One centimeter is equal to 1/100 of a meter (m). One centimeter is equal to 10 millimeters (mm). One centimeter is equal to 1/2.54 of an inch (in).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides basic unit relationships useful for understanding conversions to other metric and imperial units (meters, millimeters, inches).

rubrics_metrics.name: Foot definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Foot (ft) is a unit of length. One foot is equal to 12 inches (in). One foot is equal to 1/3 of a yard (yd). One foot is equal to 30.48 centimeters (cm).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: States the exact centimeter equivalence (30.48 cm) which is used as the conversion factor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary conversion factor (1 cm to ft)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives the numeric factor for direct multiplication if converting single centimeters to feet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion formula (cm to ft)
rubrics_metrics.description: The distance d in feet (ft) is equal to the distance d in centimeters (cm) divided by 30.48: d(ft) = d(cm) / 30.48. Or feet = centimeters / 30.48.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preferred algebraic form for converting any centimeter value to feet; equivalent to multiplying by 0.0328084.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worked example: 20 cm to feet
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrates applying the formula to a concrete value and shows intermediate division with unit annotation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worked example: 50 cm to feet
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Second example showing the same process for a larger, round-number input.

rubrics_metrics.name: How many feet in a centimeter (reiteration)
rubrics_metrics.description: One centimeter is equal to 0.0328084 feet: 1cm = 1cm / 30.48cm/ft = 0.0328084ft
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reiterates the per-unit conversion for quick reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: How many centimeters in a foot
rubrics_metrics.description: One foot is equal to 30.48 centimeters: 1ft = 30.48×1ft = 30.48cm
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives the inverse relationship used when converting feet to centimeters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short worked procedure (convert 10 cm example)
rubrics_metrics.description: How to convert 10cm to feet: Divide 10 centimeters by 30.48 to get feet: 10cm = 10cm / 30.48cm/ft = 0.328084ft
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows the same formula applied to a small round input as a quick-howto example.

rubrics_metrics.name: Centimeters-to-feet conversion table
rubrics_metrics.description: Table mapping many specific centimeter values to feet (e.g., 1 cm = 0.032808 ft; 10 cm = 0.328084 ft; 100 cm = 3.280840 ft, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides quick-look reference values for commonly used lengths to avoid recalculation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related conversions and tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Links and references to related pages/tools such as Feet to cm, cm to inches, BMI calculator, height converter, and other length conversion pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Points users to additional converters and calculators if they need alternative units or compound conversions (feet+inches).
